incumbent.name: Terry R. Holt
incumbent.summary: Terry R. Holt, a Republican, is Fountain County sheriff; a committee to re-elect him advertised in spring 2022, and he was unopposed in the November 2022 general election, indicating he is in a second consecutive term {fcc_holt_2022} {fc_general_2022}. He is not on the 2026 sheriff ballot {fc_primary_2026} {in_list}.
record: April–May 2022: The Committee to Re-elect Terry Holt Fountain County Sheriff bought radio advertising, according to a station's FCC political file {fcc_holt_2022}.
November 2022: Holt was the only candidate for sheriff on the general-election ballot and received 4,336 votes, per the county's unofficial results {fc_general_2022}.

May 2026: A candidate listed as Terry R. Holt finished third of four in the Republican primary for County Commissioner District 3 with 24.26% of the vote; Kerry Randles won with 36.79% {fc_primary_2026}.

race_context: This is an open seat. Sheriff Holt is not on the 2026 sheriff ballot, which is consistent with Indiana's two-consecutive-term limit if he is in his second term {fcc_holt_2022} {fc_general_2022} {in_list}.

Five Republicans ran in the May 5, 2026 primary. Official results: Andrew Krout 1,475 votes (40.36%), Jon Clawson 932 (25.50%), Robert D. (Bobby) Bass 903 (24.71%), Richard Livengood 316 (8.65%) and Rocky L. Brown II 29 (0.79%) {fc_primary_2026}.
Paul Davis is running as an independent {in_list} {goodparty_davis}.
